name: Barrett Petfood
old_description: Barrett Petfood was founded on a simple promise: If we wouldn’t feed it to our own pets, you won’t find it in our products. We help pets and pet food companies thrive by delivering a premium manufacturing and brand services experience that takes pet food from idea to bowl with integrity.
about:
Barrett Petfood is headquartered in Brainerd, Minnesota. The company was founded in 2006 when agricultural entrepreneur Mike Barrett purchased a piece of equipment intended for agricultural manufacturing, only to discover it was suited for food production. Mike and his children, Tom and Sarah Barrett, pivoted the business into pet food, with Mike later transitioning ownership to his children while continuing to supply ingredients from his farm. The company remains family-owned.

Barrett operates two facilities in central Minnesota: the original Brainerd plant and a second site opened in 2020 in Little Falls that added 160,000 square feet and two production lines. The company produces hundreds of formulas across super‑premium kibble, kibble‑plus, and freeze‑dried formats, using extrusion, milling, and automated packaging lines. Its capabilities span diet formulation, ingredient sourcing, processing, packaging, and distribution.

Barrett serves pet food brands ranging from emerging labels to market leaders, manufacturing diets for dogs, cats, reptiles, birds, livestock, and zoo animals. Customers rely on the company as a full‑service co‑manufacturer that handles everything from formulation to shipping.

The business was built on a simple promise: “If we wouldn’t feed it to our own pets, you won’t find it in our products.” The Barretts emphasize a relationship‑based philosophy, a “Don’t Say No” innovation mindset, and rigorous, laboratory‑like food‑safety standards as their differentiators.
